title: Refinement vs. Replanning: Inference Compute Allocation in Robot Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.19034v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A frozen chunked robot policy can spend deployment-time inference compute in two coupled ways: more work within each policy call to refine a predicted action chunk, or more frequent policy calls to replan from fresh observations. We study this allocation without updating model weights. Our evaluation procedure reports success with both nominal compute rate and complete attempt cost, selects comparisons on discovery tasks, and tests prespecified comparisons on held-out tasks. Comparisons added after inspecting the held-out results only summarize observed patterns. We demonstrate the procedure with one frozen SmolVLA checkpoint in synchronous LIBERO simulation, using denoising count as the refinement control and fixing chunk length at K=50. translated_title: 精炼 vs. 重新规划：机器人策略中的推理计算分配
translated_abstract: 一个冻结的分块机器人策略可以通过两种相互耦合的方式来消耗部署时的推理计算：在每次策略调用内部投入更多计算以精炼预测的动作块，或者更频繁地调用策略以根据最新观测进行重新规划。我们在不更新模型权重的前提下研究这种计算分配问题。我们的评估程序同时报告名义计算速率下的成功率以及完整尝试的成本，在发现任务上选择比较对象，并在保留任务上测试预先指定的比较。仅在查看保留结果之后补充的比较只用于总结观察到的模式。我们使用一个冻结的 SmolVLA 检查点在同步 LIBERO 仿真中演示了该评估程序，以去噪次数作为精炼控制手段，并将动作块长度固定为 K=50。算术运算量与延迟对成本的刻画方式不同：在 d=10 时，82.1% 的统计算术量与去噪无关，而对固定输入主机时间进行描述性仿射拟合则将 17.7% 归于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文研究了冻结的分块机器人策略在部署时应如何分配推理计算——是在每次策略调用内投入更多计算精炼动作块，还是更频繁地调用策略重新规划，并提出了一种同时考虑名义计算速率成功率和完整尝试成本的评估程序。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates how a frozen chunked robot policy should allocate deployment-time inference compute—between refining predicted action chunks within each policy call and replanning more frequently from fresh observations—proposing an evaluation procedure that reports both nominal compute rate success and complete attempt cost.
